content_en.prompt: Five snowmen stand in a line. From left to right each receives a hat according to its size. Hats are on a stack, distributed from top to bottom.
content_en.question: Which stack of hats belongs to which line of snowmen?
content_en.explanation: For D, each line of snowmen matches its hat stack exactly by size order (whether descending, ascending, or a specific pairing). A, B, C fail because the smallest snowman in the first line would end up with a mismatched hat size.
content_en.ct_explanation: Assigning each snowman its own hat without changing order is a structure-preserving map — comparing two tuples (ordered sequences) of sizes. Hats form a stack (pop/push, only top accessible); snowmen form a queue (dequeue/enqueue, only front accessible). One can remove an element from each and compare — if they don't match, the pairing is wrong.

content_zh.prompt: 五個雪人排成一列。從左到右，每個雪人會依照大小拿到屬於自己的帽子。帽子疊成一疊，從最上面開始依序發放。
content_zh.question: 哪一疊帽子對應到哪一列雪人？
content_zh.explanation: 方案D裡，每一列雪人都能跟該疊帽子依照大小順序完全對應（不論是遞減、遞增、或特定配對方式）。方案A、B、C都會出現第一列裡最小的雪人拿到不合尺寸帽子的情況。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 在不改變順序的情況下，把每個雪人配上「屬於自己」的帽子，這叫做「結構保持映射」——本質上是比較兩組依大小排列的序列（tuple）。帽子是用「堆疊」(stack)的方式呈現（只能從最上面取用，pop/push）；雪人則是用「佇列」(queue)的方式呈現（只能從最前面取用，dequeue/enqueue）。從兩邊各取一個元素比對，只要對不上，這個配對方式就是錯的。
